fr: Éléments de géométrie algébrique
scope: work title
decision: Use 代数几何原理 for EGA; retain 代数几何基础 for the distinct FGA title already used by that corpus.

fr: géométrie algébrique
scope: general

fr: schéma
scope: scheme theory

fr: préschéma
scope: historical EGA I distinction: prescheme versus separated scheme
decision: Use 预概形 provisionally to preserve EGA's historical distinction; replace only if a stronger mainland research witness is found.

fr: variété algébrique
scope: classical algebraic geometry

fr: morphisme
scope: categorical/algebraic-geometric morphisms
decision: Use 态射 for morphisme and 映射 for application where the French distinction is material.

fr: faisceau
scope: sheaf theory

fr: langage fonctoriel
scope: Introduction

fr: compactification
scope: algebraic geometry

fr: faisceau dualisant relatif
scope: duality and moduli

fr: faisceau localement libre
scope: modules and vector bundles

fr: suite exacte
scope: homological algebra

fr: racine d'un idéal
alternatives: 根式理想（当所指为该理想本身时）
scope: commutative algebra
decision: Use 理想的根 for EGA's operator/object wording; use 根式理想 when the predicate rather than the operator is meant.

fr: nilradical
scope: ring theory
decision: Use 幂零根; preserve 诣零根 as an attested competing form.

fr: radical d'un anneau (intersection des idéaux maximaux)
scope: ring theory
decision: Use Jacobson 根 because both independently checked mainland sources use the exact form and EGA defines this specific radical.

fr: anneau réduit
scope: commutative algebra

fr: partie multiplicative
scope: localization
decision: Use 乘法子集 to match the checked definition and established Chinese Stacks register.

fr: anneau/module de fractions; localisation
scope: localization
decision: Retain EGA's historical object names 分式环/分式模 while using 局部化 for the operation and modern explanatory context.

fr: problème d'application universelle
scope: universal property of localization
decision: Use 泛映射问题 for the authority's noun phrase; register 泛性质 as the modern explanatory equivalent, not as a silent structural rewrite.

fr: morphisme fonctoriel; transformation naturelle
scope: category-theoretic compatibility of localization maps
decision: Preserve the authority's explicit synonymy: 函子性态射（或自然变换）.

fr: support
scope: sheaves and cycles
decision: Use 支撑 as the noun and verb in sheaf-theoretic contexts.

fr: espace irréductible; composante irréductible
zh: 不可约空间；不可约分支
scope: topology and scheme theory
decision: Use 不可约空间 for the property and 不可约分支 for maximal irreducible closed subsets, matching the established Chinese Stacks topology register.

fr: point générique
scope: irreducible spaces and schemes
decision: Use 泛点 to standardize with the live mainland Chinese Stacks topology corpus while preserving 生成点 and 广点 as attested variants.

fr: spécialisation; générisation
scope: specialization order on topological spaces
decision: Use 特化/一般化 at EGA I 2.1.2 to align the foundational topology definition and avoid overloading the machine-learning sense of 泛化; retain 泛化 as an attested corpus variant.

fr: espace noethérien; quasi-compact
scope: topology and schemes

fr: préfaisceau; faisceau à valeurs dans K
zh: 预层；取值于 K 的层
scope: category-valued sheaves
decision: Use 预层 and the explicit construction 取值于 K 的层/预层.

fr: fibre (d’un faisceau); germe
scope: sheaf theory; EGA historical fibre terminology
decision: Translate EGA’s historical fibre as 茎 in the sheaf context and germe as 芽; reserve 纤维 for geometric fibres.

fr: limite inductive; limite projective
scope: category theory and sheaves
decision: Use 归纳极限/逆极限 for the EGA pair, preserving the categorical duality and the established edition register.

fr: base d'ouverts; préfaisceau sur une base
en: open basis; presheaf on a basis
zh: 拓扑基；拓扑基上的预层
alternatives: 开集基；开集基上的预层
scope: topological bases and sheaves
decision: Use 拓扑基 and 拓扑基上的预层; retain 开集基 as a transparent but nonpreferred variant.

fr: système projectif
scope: category-theoretic systems indexed by a preorder
decision: Use 逆系统 so the system/limit pair reads 逆系统/逆极限.

fr: cofinal
scope: ordered neighbourhood and covering systems
decision: Use 共尾, with 共尾集 or 共尾系 according to the grammatical head.

fr: exact à gauche
scope: functors and categorical exactness
decision: Use 左正合 throughout EGA.

fr: recollement; condition de recollement
scope: sheaves and descent data
decision: Use 粘合 and 粘合条件 for EGA's recollement terminology; keep 胶合 as a recognized nonpreferred variant.

fr: image directe; foncteur image directe
scope: presheaves, sheaves and morphisms of spaces
decision: Use 直像 and 直像函子 in the EGA sheaf-theoretic register; reserve 推前 for contexts where a later source explicitly lexicalizes pushforward.

fr: image réciproque; préfaisceau image réciproque; faisceau image réciproque
en: inverse image; inverse-image presheaf; inverse-image sheaf
scope: presheaves, sheaves and morphisms of spaces
decision: Use 逆像 as the general noun and 逆像预层/逆像层 when the presheaf-versus-sheaf distinction is material; do not replace the universal construction with the less specific 拉回.

fr: faisceau associé au préfaisceau; faisceau associé
en: sheaf associated to a presheaf; sheafification
scope: sheafification and its universal property
decision: Render EGA's faisceau associé construction as the established operation 层化 while preserving its complete universal-property definition.

fr: préfaisceau constant; faisceau simple; faisceau localement simple
en: constant presheaf; constant sheaf; locally constant sheaf
zh: 常值预层；常值层；局部常值层
scope: EGA I §3.6 historical simple-sheaf terminology
decision: Use 常值预层 for constant presheaf, and translate EGA’s historical faisceau simple/faisceau localement simple as 常值层/局部常值层, preserving the complete definition rather than the French adjective literally.

fr: espace pseudo-discret; groupe pseudo-discret; anneau pseudo-discret
en: pseudo-discrete space; pseudo-discrete group; pseudo-discrete ring
zh: 伪离散空间；伪离散群；伪离散环
scope: EGA I §3.8 topological-space, group and ring sheaves
decision: Use the exact-work official mainland prefix 伪离散 consistently for spaces, groups, rings and their sheaves.

fr: recollement; condition de recollement
scope: sheaves, ringed spaces and descent data
decision: Use 黏合 and 黏合条件. Boundedly normalize the seven previously translated EGA I §3.3 loci and use 黏合 in §4.1.7 onward.

fr: espace annelé; espace topologiquement annelé; faisceau structural
en: ringed space; topologically ringed space; structure sheaf
zh: 赋环空间；拓扑赋环空间；结构层
scope: EGA I §4 and later scheme-theoretic contexts
decision: Use 赋环空间 because a current mainland algebraic-geometry definition directly pairs it with 结构层 and it aligns with the established Chinese Stacks/FGA cross-corpus register; retain 环积空间 and 环层空间 as explicit alternatives.

fr: faisceau quasi-cohérent; faisceau cohérent
scope: EGA I §5 and later scheme-theoretic module-sheaf contexts
decision: Use 拟凝聚层 and 凝聚层 consistently in EGA I §5 and later volumes.

fr: espace annelé en anneaux locaux; corps résiduel
scope: EGA I §5.5 and later local-ringed-space contexts
decision: Normalize the three EGA I §5.5 occurrences to 局部赋环空间 and retain 剩余域.

fr: platitude; module plat; fidèlement plat; morphisme plat
en: flatness; flat module; faithfully flat; flat morphism
zh: 平坦性；平坦模；忠实平坦；平坦态射
scope: EGA I §6 and later algebraic-geometry flatness contexts
decision: Use 平坦性, 平坦模, 忠实平坦 and 平坦态射 throughout EGA.

fr: anneau de valuation discrète; sans torsion
scope: EGA I §6.3.4 and later valuation/module contexts
decision: Use 离散赋值环 and 无挠 in the algebraic-geometry register.

fr: anneau préadmissible; anneau admissible; idéal de définition; anneau préadique; anneau adique; topologie J-adique
en: preadmissible ring; admissible ring; ideal of definition; preadic ring; adic ring; J-adic topology
zh: 预可容许环；可容许环；定义理想；预-adic 环；adic 环；J-adic 拓扑
scope: EGA I §7 and later formal/adic geometry
decision: Use adic and 预-adic as the ring/topology stem in EGA, with 可容许环 and 定义理想; retain I-进 as a current mainland alternative for cross-corpus normalization work.

fr: limite projective; séparé complété; théorème de Krull; lemme d'Artin-Rees
en: projective/inverse limit; separated completion; Krull theorem; Artin-Rees lemma
zh: 逆极限；分离完备化；Krull 定理；Artin--Rees 引理
scope: EGA I §7 and later inverse-limit/completion arguments
decision: Use 逆极限 in running EGA prose, 分离完备化 for séparé complété, and the established proper names Krull 定理 and Artin--Rees 引理.

fr: anneau admissible; anneau préadique; anneau adique; module quasi-fini
en: admissible ring; preadic ring; adic ring; quasi-finite module
zh: 可容环；预进制环；进制环；拟有限模
alternatives: 可容许环；预-adic 环；adic 环
scope: EGA I §7 and later formal/algebraic-geometry contexts
decision: Use the exact-work official forms 进制环, 可容环 and 拟有限模. Preserve the explicit French preadic/adic distinction as 预进制/进制 in running prose. Continue to use 逆极限 while recording the publisher's 投影极限 as a target-specific variant.

fr: somme (topologique) de préschémas
scope: EGA I §3.1 geometric disjoint-union construction and its universal property
decision: Use 预概形的不交并 as the §3.1 heading and 不交并 in the construction; preserve the displayed coproduct symbol and universal property rather than replacing it by prose-only 余积.

fr: changement/extension du préschéma de base; image réciproque
en: base change/change of base; inverse image
zh: 换基；经换基所得的预概形；逆像
scope: EGA I §3.3.6--3.3.8: change of base for preschemes and morphisms
decision: Use 换基 in the §3.3 heading and construction; say 经由 φ 从 S 到 S' 换基所得的预概形 and retain 逆像 where the authority explicitly gives image réciproque. Do not globally replace 基变换 or 基扩张 in other contexts.

fr: point à valeurs dans T; point géométrique; localité/localisé en; corps des valeurs; point rationnel sur K; produit fibré
en: T-valued point; geometric point; locality/lying at; field of values; K-rational point; fibre product
zh: 取值在/取值于 T 的点（可缩写 T-值点）；几何点；所在点/位于 x 上；取值域；K-有理点；纤维积
alternatives: 定义在 T 上的点
scope: EGA I §3.4, especially the exact subsection heading and geometric-point register
decision: Use the exact-work heading syntax ‘预概形的取值在预概形中的点；几何点’, retaining 预概形 under the diplomatic French distinction. Use ‘取值于 T 的点’ in expanded running prose, 几何点, 所在点/位于 x 上, 取值域, K-有理点 and 纤维积 contextually.

fr: surjection; injection; universellement injectif; morphisme radiciel; extension radicielle
en: surjection; injection; universally injective; radicial morphism; radicial/purely inseparable extension
zh: 映满和含容（标题）；满射/单射（行文）；普遍单射；根态射；纯不可分扩张
alternatives: 映满/含容作为行文术语
scope: EGA I §3.5: underlying-space surjectivity/injectivity and radicial morphisms
decision: Use the exact HEP heading 映满和含容. In running prose use 满射/单射 for the underlying maps, 普遍单射 and 根态射 for the scheme-theoretic property, and 纯不可分扩张 for extension radicielle. Do not globally replace these contextual forms.

fr: réduction mod. J; propre sur A
en: reduction modulo J; proper over A
zh: 模 J 约化；在 A 上固有
alternatives: 模了约化（出版社目录的纯文本字形）
scope: EGA I §3.7: reduction of a prescheme modulo an ideal and properness over a discrete valuation ring
decision: Render the heading and operation as 模 J 约化 while preserving the exact TeX ideal symbol, never lexicalizing the catalog's 了 glyph. Use 在 A 上固有 for propre sur A, matching the checked mainland Stacks mathematical-example register.

fr: sous-préschéma; morphisme d'injection canonique; restrictions aux fibres; majoré par
en: subprescheme; canonical injection morphism; restrictions to stalks; factors through
zh: 子预概形；典范嵌入态射；在各茎上的限制；可经由……分解
scope: EGA I §4.1: subpreschemes, the canonical morphism into the ambient prescheme, stalk maps, and the defined factor-through order relation
decision: Use 子预概形 and 典范嵌入态射, keeping the latter distinct from the later 浸入态射. Translate the historical fibres as 茎. Render majoré semantically and reversibly as 可经由……分解 throughout §4.1.8-4.1.10 instead of inventing a lexicalized upper-bound term.

fr: morphisme d'immersion; immersion; immersion ouverte; immersion fermée; morphisme d'injection; factorisation canonique; transport de structure
en: immersion morphism; immersion; open immersion; closed immersion; injection morphism; canonical factorization; transport of structure
zh: 浸入态射；浸入；开浸入；闭浸入；嵌入态射；典范分解；结构传递
scope: EGA I §4.2 and later immersion theory; keep the defined immersion family distinct from the canonical subprescheme injection morphism
decision: Use 浸入态射 for the section-level notion and 浸入/开浸入/闭浸入 in propositions. Keep morphisme d'injection as 嵌入态射 and its canonical form as 典范嵌入态射. Use 典范分解 and 结构传递 contextually. Do not globally collapse 浸入 and 嵌入.

fr: produit d'immersions; algèbre quotient; spectre premier; extension du préschéma de base
en: product of immersions; quotient algebra; prime spectrum; extension/base change of the base prescheme
zh: 浸入的积；商代数；素谱；基预概形的扩张
scope: EGA I §4.3, products and base extensions of immersions
decision: Use 浸入的积 as the subsection heading, 商代数 and 素谱 in the affine proof, and 基预概形的任意扩张 in Corollary 4.3.2. Retain 换基 for the operation where it is named as such; make no global replacement.

fr: image réciproque; majoré par; borne inférieure; faisceau quasi-cohérent d'idéaux; fibre
en: inverse image; factors through; greatest lower bound; quasi-coherent sheaf of ideals; fibre
zh: 逆像；可经由……分解；下确界；拟凝聚理想层；纤维
scope: EGA I §4.4: inverse-image subpreschemes, their universal factorization property, meet in the subprescheme order and defining ideal sheaves
decision: Use 子预概形的逆像 as the heading and 逆像 in running prose. Preserve the direction of majoré par by 可经由 j 分解, use 下确界 for borne inférieure, 拟凝聚理想层 for the defining ideal object and 纤维 for the closed-point fibre. Do not globally replace contextual alternatives.

fr: immersion locale; isomorphisme local; morphisme dominant; préschéma irréductible
en: local immersion; local isomorphism; dominant morphism; irreducible prescheme
zh: 局部浸入；局部同构；支配态射；不可约预概形
scope: EGA I §4.5, local forms of immersions and isomorphisms and the dominant-map criterion
decision: Use 局部浸入 and 局部同构 as the defined terms, 支配态射 for dominant morphism, and 不可约预概形 for the historical EGA object. Use 单射的支配态射 for injectif dominant without inventing a compound technical term.

fr: préschéma réduit; nilradical; fibre d'un module en un point; espace sous-jacent
en: reduced prescheme; nilradical; stalk of a module at a point; underlying space
zh: 约化预概形；幂零根；模在一点的茎；底空间
scope: EGA I §5.1 opening definitions and the nilradical construction, especially I.5.1.1-I.5.1.2
decision: Use 约化预概形 and 约化子预概形 for reduced preschemes, 幂零根 for the nilradical, 茎 for the sheaf/module object at a point, and 底空间 for the underlying topological space. This is contextual and makes no global replacement of 既约 in inherited corpora.

fr: morphisme diagonal; diagonale; graphe d'un morphisme; morphisme graphe; monomorphisme; immersion canonique
en: diagonal morphism; diagonal; graph of a morphism; graph morphism; monomorphism; canonical immersion
zh: 对角态射；对角线；态射的图；图态射；单态射；典范浸入
scope: EGA I §§5.2-5.3, especially I.5.3.1-I.5.3.17
decision: Use 对角态射 for the morphism Delta, 对角线 for its associated subprescheme/image, 态射的图 and 图态射 for graph objects/arrows, 单态射 for categorical monomorphism, and 典范浸入 for immersion canonique. Preserve the existing 浸入 versus 嵌入 distinction contextually.

fr: morphisme séparé; préschéma séparé; Y-schéma; schéma (terminologie historique d'EGA I); critère de séparation
en: separated morphism; separated prescheme; Y-scheme; scheme (historical EGA I terminology); separation criterion
zh: 分离态射；分离预概形；Y-概形；概形（EGA I 历史术语）；分离判据
scope: EGA I §§5.4-5.5, the definition, stability properties and criteria for separatedness
decision: Use 分离态射 and 分离预概形 for the defined properties, Y-概形 for the historical source term, 概形 for EGA I's separated-prescheme sense, and 分离判据 for the criterion subsection. Preserve the historical scope explicitly rather than modernizing the French mathematics.

fr: espace noethérien; préschéma noethérien; localement connexe; composante connexe; composante irréductible
en: Noetherian space; Noetherian prescheme; locally connected; connected component; irreducible component
zh: Noether 空间；Noether 预概形；局部连通；连通分支；不可约分支
scope: EGA I §6.1, Noetherian finiteness and connected/irreducible component topology
decision: Use Noether consistently in this EGA unit; use 局部连通 and 连通分支, paired with 不可约分支. Normalize only the active ega1-6 target's initial draft from 诺特 to Noether; make no unrelated global replacement.

fr: préschéma artinien; anneau artinien; schéma artinien; espace discret; condition T_1; composé direct; somme topologique
en: Artinian prescheme; Artinian ring; Artinian scheme; discrete space; T1 condition; direct product; topological sum
zh: Artin预概形；Artin环；Artin概形；离散空间；T_1条件；直积；拓扑和
alternatives: 阿廷预概形/阿廷环/阿廷概形
scope: EGA I §6.2, the affine Artinian-prescheme definition and finite discrete decomposition
decision: Use Artin预概形, Artin环 and Artin概形 in this exact EGA I edition; use 离散空间, T_1条件, 直积 and 拓扑和. Preserve 阿廷 and Artinian as documented variants outside this exact-work scope and make no unrelated replacement.

fr: morphisme de type fini; algèbre de type fini; préschéma de type fini sur Y; local sur Y; morphisme localement de type fini; morphisme de présentation finie
en: morphism of finite type; algebra of finite type; prescheme of finite type over Y; local on Y; morphism locally of finite type; morphism of finite presentation
zh: 有限型态射；有限型代数；Y上的有限型预概形；对Y是局部的；局部有限型态射；有限表示态射
scope: EGA I §6.3 and later exact occurrences; preserve the distinctions among finite, finite type and finite presentation
decision: Use 有限型态射, 有限型代数, Y上的有限型预概形, 对Y是局部的, 局部有限型态射 and 有限表示态射 in their exact mathematical senses. Preserve 有限生成代数 as a documented stylistic synonym only; make no unrelated global replacement.

fr: K-préschéma algébrique; corps de base; K-schéma algébrique; schéma fini sur K; rang; rang séparable; nombre géométrique de points; degré de transcendance; fibre
en: algebraic K-prescheme; base field; algebraic K-scheme; scheme finite over K; rank; separable rank/degree; geometric number of points; transcendence degree; fiber
zh: K-代数预概形；基域；K-代数概形；K上的有限概形；秩；可分秩；几何点数；超越次数；纤维
alternatives: K上的有限型预概形（definition-explicit paraphrase）
scope: EGA I §6.4, preserving the historical prescheme/scheme distinction and the exact EGA-series invariant register
decision: Use K-代数预概形 and K-代数概形 according to the French object; 基域; K上的有限概形; 秩; exact-series 可分秩; 几何点数; 超越次数; and 纤维. Preserve 可分次数 as the general field-theory alternative outside this exact EGA-series scope. Make no unrelated global replacement.

fr: application rationnelle; fonction rationnelle; faisceau des fonctions rationnelles; di-homomorphisme; faisceau simple; faisceau de torsion; sans torsion; rang
en: rational map; rational function; sheaf of rational functions; di-homomorphism; constant sheaf; torsion sheaf; torsion-free; rank
zh: 有理映射；有理函数；有理函数层；双同态；常值层；挠层；无挠；秩
scope: EGA I §7, including the exact four subsection headings and the rational-function/torsion-sheaf register
decision: Use the official exact-work §7 headings verbatim. Use 有理映射 and 有理函数 throughout, 有理函数层 for the associated sheaf, 双同态 for the already-defined historical di-homomorphism, 常值层 for faisceau simple, and 挠层/无挠/秩 in the torsion register. Preserve the listed alternatives as contextual evidence without global replacement.

fr: morphisme quasi-compact; morphisme localement de type fini; préschéma réduit; immersion locale; morphisme dominant
en: quasi-compact morphism; morphism locally of finite type; reduced prescheme; local immersion; dominant morphism
zh: 拟紧态射；局部有限型态射；约化预概形；局部浸入；支配态射
scope: EGA I §6.6, including the exact subsection heading and the reduction step in I.6.6.5
decision: Use the official exact-work heading 拟紧态射和局部有限型态射, retain 拟紧 throughout §6.6, and use 约化 for French réduit in I.6.6.5. Continue the established 局部浸入 and 支配态射 forms. Preserve all alternatives as contextual evidence without global replacement.

fr: schéma de Chevalley; anneaux locaux apparentés; domine; relation de domination
en: Chevalley scheme; allied local rings; dominates; domination relation
zh: Chevalley概形；同源的局部环；支配；支配关系
scope: EGA I §8.1-§8.3, especially the defined order on local subrings of a field and the Chevalley-scheme reconstruction
decision: Use the official exact-work forms Chevalley概形 and 同源的局部环. Use 支配 and 支配关系 for the defined order on local subrings, following the checked published mainland algebraic-geometry monograph and preserving 优于 as an established adverse alternative.

fr: produit tensoriel; image directe; prolongement; image fermée; adhérence; faisceau quasi-cohérent d'algèbres; changement du faisceau structural
en: tensor product; direct image; extension; scheme-theoretic/closed image; closure; quasi-coherent sheaf of algebras; change of structure sheaf
zh: 张量积；直像；延拓；闭像预概形（现代交叉索引：概形论像）；闭包（概形论闭包）；准凝聚代数层；结构层的改变
scope: EGA I §9.1-§9.6.6 only; distinguish the printed historical image fermée construction from an ordinary topological image and retain modern Stacks crosswalks
decision: Use 张量积, 直像 and 延拓 consistently with the established EGA/Stacks register. In §9.5 use 闭像预概形 and 闭包 while recording 概形论像/概形论闭包 as the modern crosswalk and 概像/概闭包 as the official exact-work historical forms. Use 准凝聚代数层 and 结构层的改变 in §9.6. Make no unrelated global replacement.

fr: schéma formel; schéma formel affine; spectre formel; morphisme de schémas formels affines; anneau admissible; faisceau d'anneaux topologiques pseudo-discrets; système projectif; limite projective
en: formal scheme; formal affine scheme; formal spectrum; morphism of formal affine schemes; admissible ring; pseudo-discrete sheaf of topological rings; inverse system; inverse limit
zh: 形式概形；仿射形式概形；形式谱；仿射形式概形的态射；可容环；伪离散拓扑环层；逆系统；逆极限
scope: EGA I §10.1-§10.2 and later formal-geometry occurrences
decision: Use the official exact-work headings 形式概形, 仿射形式概形 and 仿射形式概形的态射; use 形式谱 for Spf(A), 可容环 for anneau admissible, 伪离散拓扑环层 for the defined sheaf, and the established pair 逆系统/逆极限 in running prose. Preserve the listed historical alternatives without global replacement.

fr: produit de préschémas formels; complété formel d'un préschéma le long d'une partie fermée; cofinal
en: product of formal preschemes; formal completion of a prescheme along a closed subset; cofinal
zh: 形式预概形的积；概形沿着一个闭子集的形式完备化；共尾
scope: EGA I §10.7-§10.8; categorical product terminology, exact section heading, and cofinal subsystem language
decision: Use 形式预概形的积 in §10.7, preserving the frozen source's prescheme distinction and the established §3 categorical register; record 形式概形的纤维积 as the exact-work publisher alternative. Use the exact official §10.8 heading 概形沿着一个闭子集的形式完备化 and use 共尾 for cofinal. Replace only the eight new §10.7 categorical 乘积 occurrences; do not globally rewrite other senses of product.

fr: morphisme adique de préschémas formels; préschéma adique; système inductif adique
en: adic morphism of formal preschemes; adic prescheme; adic inductive system
zh: 形式预概形间的进制态射；进制预概形；进制归纳系
alternatives: 形式概形间的进制态射
scope: EGA I §10.12 only; preserve the diplomatic source's préschéma distinction while using the exact-work mainland adic register
decision: Use 形式预概形间的进制态射 as the source-faithful section heading, 进制态射 in running prose, 进制 S-预概形 for the relative object, and 进制归纳系 for the associated inductive system. Preserve the publisher's 形式概形间的进制态射 as an exact-work alternative; make no unrelated global replacement.
